items.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
items.description: Canada is seeking closer ties with EU after a breakdown in relations with the US and its president Donald Trump.

items.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
items.description: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.

items.title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
items.description: The star said he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped from the line-up after he made pro-Palestinian statements on stage.

items.title: At least 20 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
items.description: Dozens of people are missing beneath the rubble of the building in Gaza City, where some 10 families had been living.

items.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
items.description: The inspector also found a bottleneck in resupply, despite President Donald Trump's claims that US supplies are "virtually limitless".

items.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
items.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".

items.title: Journalist and pilot among three killed after news helicopter crashes in LA
items.description: The NBCLA news helicopter was flying near the scene of a fatal bus crash.

items.title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
items.description: Police have not linked the deaths to a serial killer but are investigating this possibility.

items.title: US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination
items.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says South Africa has not addressed US concerns over racial inequality.

items.title: Philippines' Duterte seen in person for first time at International Criminal Court
items.description: He is due to be tried for crimes against humanity over thousands of deaths linked to his war on drugs.

items.title: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
items.description: The two countries accounted for 52% of killings of environmental activists in 2025, according to Global Witness.

items.title: Legendary Nigerian actor Olu Jacobs dies aged 84
items.description: Olu Jacobs was one of Nigeria's most recognised actors, whose career spanned several decades.

items.title: Tall athletes can't stretch their legs in container beds at Asian Games, official says
items.description: South Korea's delegation slams the wooden containers housing its athletes at the Asian Games in Nagoya city.

items.title: Lost on Mount Fuji off-season? You'll have to pay for your rescue
items.description: The fee will be imposed on those who get lost on Japan's most famous mountain during the off-peak seasons.

items.title: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
items.description: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

items.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
items.description: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.

items.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
items.description: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.

items.title: Satellite image reveals major damage that shut crucial Saudi oil pipeline
items.description: Experts tell BBC Verify the pipeline's closure could cut oil supplies by as much as 3.6 million barrels per day.

items.title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
items.description: The announcement by the US points to a developing field of modern warfare in the Earth's orbit.

items.title: Five takeaways from Canada's push to woo the world's richest investors
items.description: A $1tn sales pitch, more than 160 projects on offer, pivot to the EU amid a bitter trade war with the US - takeaways from the first Canada Investment Summit.
